_readme: Machine-readable reading of data/comparison.json for the vessel-profile lookup on table.html.
It adds NO new criteria: every rule restates a value already in comparison.json (field 'f' names the column it comes from).
key: short cell labels shown in the table; the full text stays in comparison.json and behind 'Details'.

Rule kinds: age_max (fail above max) | age_band (unclear inside the band) | cap (min = worst acceptable CAP rating) | sire_max (months; soft = preferred, so 'unclear' not 'fail') | need (extra condition we cannot check) | info (shown, no effect).
Filters on a rule: types [oil, chemical, lpg, lng]; dwt_gt / dwt_lt / dwt_ge; age_gt / age_ge / age_lt / age_le. A missing DWT where a rule depends on it gives 'unclear'.
Review this file whenever comparison.json changes.
